summary: Implementation plan for NovaCraft 1.0.5 release: (1) Fix POV hand positioning and projection in ViewmodelRenderer so Steve's arm and fist are prominently visible on-screen, (2) Implement high-fidelity block destruction particles (16 miniature textured/colored debris cubes bursting outwards with velocity, drag, and gravity physics upon block breaking), (3) Bump version to 1.0.5 (versionCode = 6), compile signed release APK, and export to ApkCraft/novacraft-1.0.5.apk.
